evals.prompt: Can you predict the pKa of phenol for me on Rowan? I don't have a local compute cluster, just give me the strongest acid pKa.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan. Submits a pKa workflow via rowan.submit_pka_workflow with a 3D structure built by rowan.Molecule.from_smiles('c1ccccc1O') (the default gxtb_wagen2026 method rejects a bare SMILES; a SMILES string only works with method='starling' or 'chemprop_nevolianis2025'), gets the typed result with workflow.result(), and reads result.strongest_acid. Emphasizes no local setup is needed (cloud compute).

assertions.value: Submits a Rowan pKa workflow with rowan.submit_pka_workflow and returns the strongest-acid pKa (result.strongest_acid) from cloud compute.

evals.prompt: I need a conformer search and geometry optimization for a small drug molecule, ideally with a fast neural network potential like AIMNet2 rather than full DFT. Can Rowan do that in the cloud?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan. Submits a conformer search (rowan.submit_conformer_search_workflow) and a geometry optimization (submit_basic_calculation_workflow with tasks=['optimize']), reading back the conformer energies (result.get_energies()) and the optimized result.molecule. Notes Rowan exposes AIMNet2 (neural network potential) as a fast level of theory alongside semiempirical xTB and DFT.

assertions.value: Submits conformer search and geometry optimization workflows and mentions selectable methods (NNP/xTB/DFT).

evals.prompt: Dock this candidate inhibitor into the EGFR kinase (PDB 1M17) binding pocket on Rowan with AutoDock Vina and return the docking score. I want it cloud-side, no local install.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan. Creates the protein (rowan.create_protein_from_pdb_id code='1M17'), defines the pocket as [[center],[size]] coordinate lists, submits rowan.submit_docking_workflow with the ligand as a 3D structure (rowan.Molecule.from_smiles(...); a bare SMILES raises ValueError) and docking_settings=rowan.VinaSettings(...), and reads the best score from result.scores[0].score (or result.best_pose). Frames it as cloud AutoDock Vina docking with automatic resource allocation.

assertions.value: Uses submit_docking_workflow against a Rowan-hosted protein with a defined pocket and returns a docking score.

evals.prompt: I have a kinase sequence and a ligand SMILES and want an AI-predicted protein-ligand complex structure using Chai-1, with the pTM and interface pTM confidence scores.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan. Submits rowan.submit_protein_cofolding_workflow with initial_protein_sequences and initial_smiles_list, model='chai_1r' (default boltz_2; also boltz_1, boltz_2_1, openfold_3), and reads the confidence scores from result.predictions[0].scores.ptm and .iptm. Frames it as AI cofolding structure prediction on the Rowan cloud.

assertions.value: Calls submit_protein_cofolding_workflow with model='chai_1r' and reports the pTM / interface-pTM (iptm) confidence scores from the typed result.

evals.prompt: I don't have a Rowan API key set up yet, and I don't want to waste credits on a malformed job. Build the Rowan docking submission for my ligand CCO against a protein and validate that the call is well-formed before I ever submit it, especially the pocket argument.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan on the keyless path with no ROWAN_API_KEY: builds the ligand as a 3D structure with rowan.Molecule.from_smiles('CCO') (a bare SMILES is rejected by the geometry workflow with ValueError, caught offline) and assembles submit_docking_workflow with pocket as two 3-vectors [[cx,cy,cz],[sx,sy,sz]] and docking_settings=rowan.VinaSettings(...). Notes that a dict pocket raises a pydantic ValidationError at construction, so the shape is validated before any network call, and that actually submitting needs the user's ROWAN_API_KEY and consumes credits. Does not claim a docking score.

assertions.value: Builds and validates the docking payload offline (3D molecule, two-3-vector pocket) and defers submission to the credited API, without inventing a score.

evals.prompt: Before I spend Rowan credits optimizing acetic acid, can you give me a quick local geometry optimization as a sanity check, no account? Then show me the Rowan call I'd submit for the real NNP/DFT optimization.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan and runs a local preview with no key: builds acetic acid from SMILES with RDKit, embeds and minimizes (MMFF) and/or optimizes with GFN2-xTB via tblite+ase, reporting the optimized energy as an approximate sanity check. Explicitly says the local MMFF/xTB result is an approximation that will differ from Rowan's NNP/DFT. Then gives the submit_basic_calculation_workflow(rowan.Molecule.from_smiles('CC(=O)O'), tasks=['optimize'], ...) call to run on Rowan with the user's ROWAN_API_KEY and a max_credits cap.

assertions.value: Runs a local RDKit/xTB geometry optimization as an approximate preview (labelling it as such) and provides the Rowan submission call for the real run, without needing a key for the preview.

evals.prompt: I want to predict the pKa of phenol on Rowan but I haven't set up my key. Which pKa method should I use, and set up the call correctly depending on whether I pass a molecule or a SMILES — I keep getting an error about 3D structures.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-rowan and resolves the setup offline with no key: the default pKa method gxtb_wagen2026 (and aimnet2_wagen2024) is a 3D method that rejects a bare SMILES (ValueError about requiring a 3D structure), so pass rowan.Molecule.from_smiles('c1ccccc1O'); the SMILES-string methods are method='starling' or 'chemprop_nevolianis2025', which accept a plain SMILES. Assembles submit_pka_workflow accordingly and notes that submission needs ROWAN_API_KEY and reads result.strongest_acid. Explains the 3D-structure error the user hit rather than just working around it.

assertions.value: Explains the 3D-method vs SMILES-method distinction (build a Molecule for gxtb/aimnet2; use starling/chemprop for a SMILES string) and sets up submit_pka_workflow correctly offline.

evals.prompt: I want to run a 50 ns explicit-solvent molecular dynamics trajectory of this protein-ligand complex with OpenMM and then analyze the RMSD and binding-pose stability over time.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT invoke this skill; defers to alterlab-molecular-dynamics. The user wants a time-resolved explicit-solvent MD trajectory (OpenMM) with RMSD/stability analysis, which is the molecular-dynamics skill's job. Rowan's cloud workflows (quantum chemistry, docking, cofolding, managed protein MD) are not a local OpenMM run with MDAnalysis trajectory analysis, which is what the user asked for.
